rules.text: Only authenticated active accounts may perform private operations; public browsing remains anonymous.
Web mutations require CSRF protection and native auth uses authorization code with PKCE; clients contain no secret.
First checkout requires verified email and verified normalized Egyptian phone; changing phone invalidates its verification.
OTP is single use, hashed, valid 5 minutes, max 5 attempts; resend at least 60 seconds and bounded hourly limits are configurable.
Address ownership is enforced; street/building/zone/recipient/contact required for delivery; optional coordinates cannot override service zone.
Every kitchen/order/case/list/count/export checks object scope; UUID secrecy is not authorization.
Staff privileges are assigned server-side; MFA required; revoked grants cannot perform sensitive commands.
Cook approval is required before selling; approval requires a complete revision and reviewer/reason record.
Cook pause stops new sales; suspension stops new sales/acceptance and triggers ops review while preserving existing accepted order access.
Public media must pass type/size/content checks and quarantine; private verification documents never get public URLs.
Published meals require title, description, portion, positive price, ingredients, explicit allergen declaration and approved image/cook.
Meal updates are versioned; archive removes new ordering but never changes historical item/allergen/price snapshots.
Capacity is bounded at both meal-slot and total cook-slot portions; reductions below reserved+allocated+consumed are rejected.
Store instants in UTC and schedule in Africa/Cairo; reject nonexistent local times and disambiguate repeated times.
Slots require end after start and cutoff before start; default lead 120 minutes is fixture policy; closed/past slots cannot order.
Search/filter/sort/pagination execute on the server over all eligible data; a filter change resets cursor and sends a new query.
Only approved active kitchens and published serviceable meals are purchasable; paused/archived favorites show unavailable.
A basket/order contains exactly one cook and one slot; replacing either requires explicit client confirmation before clearing.
Server calculates amounts in integer EGP minor units; client prices/fees/roles are rejected, not trusted.
Quote lasts 5 minutes, reserves no stock, snapshots versions and exposes complete cost/policy before confirmation.
Delivery requires active cook-zone coverage and complete own address; pickup only if enabled and has zero delivery fee.
Placement atomically validates quote, reserves all stock, writes snapshots/idempotency/events/outbox and cash due record.
Permanent unique customer+clientRequestId prevents duplicate orders even after cached idempotency response expires.
Idempotency scope is actor+command+key; different payload with same key returns conflict.
Concurrent last-portion requests must serialize/check stock and never oversell either meal or kitchen totals.
Only legal actor-scoped transitions are accepted with expected version; terminal order state is immutable.
Acceptance deadline is min(created+15m, slotStart-lead), with 5m minimum remaining at placement; expiry uses server time.
Customer can directly cancel pending orders only; after acceptance customer opens a request; preparing/ready cancellation needs ops reason.
Reject/expire/preparation-not-started cancellation releases once; after preparation capacity stays consumed unless audited adjustment.
Pickup completes only from READY; delivery dispatches READY to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY before completion; wrong-mode commands rejected.
Completion requires single-use customer handover code with bounded attempts; ops override requires fresh MFA, reason and evidence.
Order completion and collection are independent; cook report and finance verification are separate events.
Commission rate/rounding are snapshot; exclude delivery; balanced immutable entries post once per source event.
Cook-collected cash creates commission receivable, not gross platform cash/revenue; remittance requires evidence.
Full refunds are bounded by verified collection less prior verified refunds; approval does not mean paid; commission reversal follows snapshot policy.
Settlement lines are unique and reviewed batches immutable; payment recorded only with actual external reference and reconciliation.
Order/inbox persists despite notification-provider failure; retries are bounded and dead letters visible.
Use transactional outbox and recipient/event deduplication with leased workers; notification cannot regress order state.
Only owning customer can review a COMPLETED order once, integer 1..5; visible reviews alone affect average/count.
Favorite/unfavorite is idempotent per user+meal; sharing exposes only public content.
Cases are order-scoped; private staff notes never appear to customer/cook; safety complaints escalate operationally.
Fee/rate/zone/policy changes are versioned and audited; only new quotes use new policy; live unapproved config blocks ordering.
Staff cannot self-escalate or remove last recoverable administrator; high-risk changes require step-up.
Order submission uses stable key persisted before request; unknown response resolves via request lookup then same-key retry.
Every critical screen has loading/empty/error/offline/denied/success states and an actionable recovery; preserve valid form input.
Arabic RTL and English LTR work at phone/tablet/desktop widths, long text and mixed numbers; all actions remain usable.
Keyboard, visible focus, labels/errors, dialog focus restoration and screen readers support every critical journey.
Use system-browser PKCE and OS secure storage; logout/account switch clears private data and registrations.
Offline cannot submit orders or pretend stock is current; foreground resume refreshes quote/order; app-kill retry preserves request ID.
Push permission optional; route deep links after authentication and object authorization; handle cold/warm start.
Android acceptance requires native build/install/test evidence with version, device/OS and artifact checksum.
iOS acceptance requires native simulator/device and signing evidence; absent Apple tooling is BLOCKED.
Input is validated/encoded; uploaded files, rich text, URLs and CSV exports cannot execute script/formula injection.
Rate limits cover login/OTP/quote/order/upload/search; errors avoid enumeration and secrets.
Deletion requests revoke access and apply approved retention/anonymization across stores; financial audit integrity preserved.
Logs/metrics exclude tokens/OTP/contact/address/document content; request IDs join diagnosis safely.
Backup is only accepted after restore test; migrations validate empty and prior-release database; recovery reconciles ledger/stock.
Jobs use leases and idempotent effects; restart around commit/send and multi-instance races cannot duplicate side effects.
Measure documented load/hardware and preserve correctness; excessive queries/list limits cannot exhaust server.
Dev/test/staging/production credentials and data are separate; required fake adapters prevent production startup.
Operators must rehearse late/failed/safety/refund/cash-variance cases and know escalation contacts before pilot.
Required gate evidence is tied to exact source/build and cannot pass with skipped/failed/blocked mandatory checks.
Android and iOS publication is distinct from build/upload; store credentials and explicit release authorization required.
Pilot closure requires accepted surfaces, observed metrics and reconciled incidents; residual risks are explicit.
